text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $65k while Ethereum trades flat, signaling caution rather than conviction among traders. The Fear & Greed index at 29 reflects genuine unease, though the uptick over the past week suggests some stabilization; this skeptical mood is typical of consolidation phases. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 56.8% paired with moderate volume ($54B) indicates capital is rotating toward the largest asset rather than flowing broadly across altcoins.
